title.de: Helfen und Alltagsaufgaben auf dem Spielplatz

visibleTargets.notes: Two children on the left; one clearly passes one red ball toward the other.
Two children in the sandbox clearly cooperate with one shared bucket and one shared spade: one child holds/steadies the bucket while the other uses the spade to put sand into that same bucket.
One child clearly placing a toy vehicle into the open storage box.
One child clearly dropping a white paper item into the black bin.
One child on the right clearly drinking from a blue water bottle.

en: The child is giving the ball.
The girl is giving the red ball to the boy.
The children are sharing.
They are sharing the bucket and spade.
The child is putting the toy away.
The child is throwing the rubbish in the bin.
The child is drinking water.
de: Das Mädchen gibt dem Jungen den roten Ball.
Die Kinder teilen sich Eimer und Schaufel.
Das Kind räumt das Spielzeug weg.
Das Kind wirft den Müll in den Mülleimer.

principle.en: Start with what the child is doing, then connect the action to its purpose or social meaning. Accept short answers and model one step more.
principle.de: Zuerst die Handlung benennen lassen und dann mit Zweck oder sozialer Bedeutung verbinden. Kurze Antworten annehmen und sprachlich um einen Schritt erweitern.
